cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Start the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Get someone else to explain, announce, or begin the emotionally difficult part.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Could you phone Mum and begin the conversation about selling the house?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked to speak to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I'll take over once you've said the word selling.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put her on speaker. You'll be there for the whole thing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's fine. Introduce the idea, and when she says my full name, I'll answer.

mechanism: A coaches a former pupil family conversation, insisting the pupil utter the dangerous opening while A remains available only afterwards.
confusable: Not refusing to be present: A accepts speakerphone but keeps B responsible for the vulnerable first words.
comparison: Performance announcement versus intimate family news.
